blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The former staff of actress-turned-politician Angelica Jones Alarva filed a complaint against her in the Office of the Ombudsman over alleged verbal abuse. Samantha Ladiana Alaisa went to the anti-graft court to file her complaint-affidavit against the provincial board member for alleged Grave Misconduct and Conduct Prejudicial to the Best Interest of the Service. “I am earnestly seeking justice for her actions and the hurtful, insulting, and degrading things she has said about me and my character,” Alaisa said in a six-page complaint which was marked as received by the anti-graft body.
